name: @activepieces/piece-pollybot-ai
description: Automate lead management with PollyBot AI chatbot integration.

apiKey.description: Your API Key starting with `sk-workspace_...`. Find your API Key in your [PollyBot Dashboard Settings](https://pollybot.app/docs/authentication).

chatbotId.description: The unique ID for the specific chatbot (e.g., `cmhm6o40a05h8mn12dv3tc456`). Learn more in the [PollyBot Authentication docs](https://pollybot.app/docs/authentication).

create_lead.name: create_lead
create_lead.description: Creates a new lead in your PollyBot chatbot.

metadata.description: Custom data as JSON object (e.g., {"company": "Tech Corp"})

aiMetadata.description: Create a new lead record (name and email required) under the configured PollyBot chatbot, optionally tagging phone, source, status, and custom metadata. Use when capturing a fresh contact. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate lead even with identical input.

get_Lead.name: get_Lead
get_Lead.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the lead to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single lead from the configured PollyBot chatbot by its unique lead ID. Use when you already have a lead ID and need its current details. Read-only and idempotent.

update_lead.name: update_lead
update_lead.description: Updates an existing lead. Supports partial updates.

id.description: The unique identifier of the lead to update.

metadata.description: Update or add custom data. Metadata is merged with existing data.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing lead in the configured PollyBot chatbot, identified by its lead ID, with a partial set of fields (name, email, phone, source, status, metadata); metadata is merged into existing data. Use when modifying a known lead. Requires at least one field to change. Idempotent: repeating the same update yields the same final state.

delete_lead.name: delete_lead
delete_lead.description: Permanently deletes a lead from your PollyBot chatbot.

id.description: The unique identifier of the lead to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a lead from the configured PollyBot chatbot by its unique lead ID. Use only when a lead should be removed for good; this cannot be undone. Idempotent on the end state once the lead is gone, though a repeat call on a missing ID may error.

list_leads.name: list_leads
list_leads.description: Retrieves a list of leads with filtering.

search.description: Search in name and email fields

aiMetadata.description: List leads for the configured PollyBot chatbot, with optional pagination (page, limit up to 100) and filtering by status, source, or a free-text search across name and email; omitting all filters returns the page unfiltered. Use to browse or find leads when you do not have a specific lead ID. Read-only and idempotent.

newLead.name: newLead
newLead.description: Triggers when a new lead is created in PollyBot AI chatbot.

chatbotid.description: The Id of the chatbot to monitor for new leads.

instruction.description:
## PollyBot AI Webhook Setup
To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your PollyBot AI account:

1. Login to your PollyBot AI account.
2. Navigate to the **Chatbots** section from the left navigation menu.
3. Select the desired chatbot for which you want to set up the webhook.
4. Go to the **Settings** tab.
5. Find the **Webhooks** section and  **Add Webhook**.
6. Choose the **Lead Created** event and specify the following URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
7. Click Save to register the webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new lead is created in the specified PollyBot AI chatbot (the LEAD_CREATED webhook event), delivering the new lead record. Events for other chatbots are filtered out by the configured Chatbot ID.

nl.## PollyBot AI Webhook Setup\nTo use thi:
## PollyBot AI Webhook setup
Om deze trigger te gebruiken, moet je handmatig een webhook instellen in je PollyBot AI account:
. Log in op je PollyBot AI account.
2. Navigeer naar de **Chatbots** sectie van het linkernavigatiemenu.
3. Selecteer de gewenste chatbot waarvoor je de webhook wilt instellen.
4. Ga naar het tabblad **Instellingen**.
5. Vind de **Webhooks** sectie en **Voeg Webhook toe**.
6. Kies het **Lead gemaakt** event en specificeer de volgende URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
``` 
 7. Klik op Opslaan om de webhook te registreren.

## PollyBot AI Webhook Setup
Um diesen Trigger zu verwenden, müssen Sie manuell einen Webhook in Ihrem PollyBot KI-Konto einrichten:
. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem PollyBot KI-Konto an.
2. Navigiere zum Abschnitt **Chatbots** aus dem linken Navigationsmenü.
3. Wählen Sie den gewünschten Chatbot, für den Sie den Webhook einrichten möchten.
4. Gehen Sie zu **Einstellungen** Tab.
5. Finden Sie den Abschnitt **Webhooks** und **Webhook** hinzufügen.
Wähle das **Lead Created** Event und gib die folgende URL an:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
``` 
 7. Klicken Sie auf Speichern, um den Webhook zu registrieren.

pt.## PollyBot AI Webhook Setup\nTo use thi:
## Configuração de Webhook AI do PollyBot
Para usar este ativador, você precisa configurar manualmente um webhook na sua conta AI do PollyBot:
. Faça login na sua conta PollyBot AI.
2. Navegue para a seção **Chatbots** no menu de navegação à esquerda.
3. Selecione o ChatBot desejado para o qual você deseja configurar o webhook.
4. Vá para a aba **Configurações**.
5. Encontre a seção **Webhooks** e **Adicionar Webhook**.
6. Escolha o evento **Criador de Leve** e especifique a seguinte URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
``` 
 7. Clique em Salvar para registrar o webhook.
